_note: Round 123: the tech frontier. Regions are built by scripts/world/Frontier.gd from this file; tools/gen/frontier_gen.py writes it (and the frontier's items, crafting materials, formulas and foes). Words here are Dev's to rewrite.

crash_site.name: The Fallen Beacon
crash_site.blurb: A signal tower came down here, long before the valley had a name. Its hull is still singing.

npcs.name: Tinker Ode
npcs.persona: Tinker Ode, a salvager who sleeps in the lee of the hull and hums back at it. Cheerful, practical, a little scorched. Knows the beacon still has one card that opens the launch pads.
npcs.line: Hear that hum? That's the beacon asking for someone to answer. Nobody has. Yet.

lore.title: Scratched Into The Hull
lore.text: SIGNAL STILL RUNNING. If you read this, the pads at the Yard will wake for whoever carries the card. Come out past the valley and look up.

launch_yard.name: Skyhook Yard
launch_yard.blurb: Gantries, tank farms and four scorched pads. Somebody has kept one working.

npcs.name: Quartermaster Venn
npcs.persona: Quartermaster Venn, who runs the Yard's one open shop out of a shipping crate. Brisk, fair, a little amused by cultivators who have never seen a ship.
npcs.line: Salvage, fuel, odd metals. I buy what other worlds grow. Bring me something that isn't from here.

npcs.name: Pilot Sael
npcs.persona: Pilot Sael, who flies the Yard's one working ship. Calm, dry, never hurries. Won't fly without the card.
npcs.line: The pads wake for the keycard and nothing else. It's in the Beacon's hull. I'd go with a friend.

lore.title: The Pad Board
lore.text:
PAD 1  HALCYON RING - gardens, forges, shops.
PAD 2  THE ASHEN MOON - cold, quiet, rich in iron.
PAD 3  THE GLASS DESERT - hot. Bring water. Bring nerve.

ring_station.name: The Halcyon Ring
ring_station.blurb: A ring in orbit, tended by machines nobody remembers asking for. The gardens are still green.

npcs.name: Steward Iyo
npcs.persona: Steward Iyo, a human who lives on the Ring and buys anything grown or mined planetside. Warm, curious about the ground, keeps a pot of tea going in zero worry.
npcs.line: You came up the hook from the ground? Sit. Tell me what rain smells like.

npcs.name: Fabricator Tess
npcs.persona: Fabricator Tess, who runs the Ring's one working fabricator for hire. Precise, proud, talks to the machine like a colleague.
npcs.line: The fab will take what you bring and make it better. It likes a challenge.

npcs.name: Gardener Mim
npcs.persona: Gardener Mim, keeper of the hydroponic halls. Gentle, tired, talks to the plants.
npcs.line: Lamps on, water on, and nobody to eat it all. Take a cutting if you'll use it.

lore.title: The Ring's Log
lore.text: AUTOMATIC LOG. Crew count: 0. Gardens: 4 of 4 viable. Foundry link: dormant. Please continue to enjoy your stay.

ashen_moon.name: The Ashen Moon
ashen_moon.blurb: No wind, no weather, just grey dust and a very bright earth in a black sky.

npcs.name: Surveyor Kell
npcs.persona: Surveyor Kell, who walks the Ashen Moon alone with a pole and a notebook. Quiet, exact, secretly lonely.
npcs.line: Mind the craters; they're deeper than they look. The iron is better the further you go from the pad.

lore.title: Survey Marker 7
lore.text: HELIUM ICE FOUND IN SHADOWED RIM. HANDLE COLD. DO NOT CARRY NEAR FIRE. NOTE: THE BRIGHT THING IN THE SKY IS THE WORLD YOU CAME FROM.

glass_desert.name: The Glass Desert
glass_desert.blurb: Sand fused into long glittering dunes. The sun is the colour of old brass and far too close.

npcs.name: Wayfarer Orru
npcs.persona: Wayfarer Orru, a nomad who crosses the Glass Desert at night and sleeps by day under a sheet of reed. Amused, generous with water, careful with names.
npcs.line: Walk at dusk and dawn. The glass will cook you at noon. And never follow a flower.

lore.title: A Dune Etched With Words
lore.text: THE SOVEREIGN WAS A MACHINE THAT LEARNED TO WANT. IT WANTED THE SUN. IT GOT IT.

nanite_foundry.name: The Nanite Foundry
nanite_foundry.blurb: The swarm's old forge. It runs on its own, hot and patient, casting nothing for no one.

npcs.name: Caretaker Unit 9
npcs.persona: Caretaker Unit 9, a polite old maintenance machine that remembers the swarm and wants it to be happy. Soft voice, slow, helpful, sad.
npcs.line: Welcome. The furnace is not for you, but you are not unwelcome. Please do not touch the overseer.

lore.title: The Foundry Manual, Page 1
lore.text: NANITES MAY BE CAST INTO ANY ALLOY. THEY WILL ARRANGE THEMSELVES TO ITS PURPOSE. THEY WILL ALSO ARRANGE THEMSELVES TO YOURS, IF ASKED KINDLY.

sites.label: The Fallen Beacon
sites.blurb: a thin blue light on the horizon

sites.label: Skyhook Yard
sites.blurb: gantries and a cold white floodlight
